About the Soul Ride Sunday Shop Ride group ride

A Sunday mountain bike ride from a downtown Prescott shop with a taproom. Two groups: a fast A team and a moderate, no-drop B team. Riders pedal 3–6 miles to the trailheads and back, then hang out on the patio.
